newsitem.title: GREECE: Drachma at record low vs dollar, up vs mark.
newsitem.headline: Drachma at record low vs dollar, up vs mark.

text.p: 1025 GMT: The drachma fell to a record low against the dollar and firmed against the mark at the Bank of Greece's daily fix, Commercial Bank figures showed.
** Dollar set at 288.400 drachmas from Friday's 286.600
** Mark set at 156.145 drachmas from previous 156.280 fix
** Ecu set at 308.71 drachmas from previous 309.300 fix
** Spot dollar quoted around 288.16/26 against the drachma and
